ayahs.tl: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb
ayahs.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَمَا كَسَبَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab
ayahs.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

ayahs.tl: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab
ayahs.en: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
